sentences.en: Most days he eats a peanut butter sandwich for lunch.
sentences.zh: 大多数的日子里，他午餐吃花生酱三明治。

sentences.en: I thought you said you were sick of peanut butter.
sentences.zh: 我以为你说你讨厌花生酱了。

sentences.en: Why didn't you tell us you were allergic to peanuts?
sentences.zh: 你怎么没告诉我们你对花生过敏呢？

senses.zh: 花生；微不足道的人，小人物；很少的钱
